item.title: Wrestling in the Blood: The Nelson Family Legacy Behind Elk River’s Turnaround
item.description: By Brian Jerzak When the Elk River Elks’ 106-pounder Aiden Tribon toed the line in the state team quarterfinals last season, it was the first time the program wrestled in the team portion of the tournament in over twenty years.
